extDescription.message: Live subtitles for any tab, transcribed and translated by your own Whisper server.

first_load_hint.message: The first time a model loads it can take up to a minute.

options_locked.message: Stop the subtitles to change these options.

server_setup_hint.message: Stream Transcription needs a WhisperLive server running on your computer or on your network.

server_unreachable.message: Can't reach the server. Is it running? Check the address and the firewall.

server_timeout.message: The server didn't answer in time.

server_help.message: How do I set up a server?

server_help_1.message: You need a WhisperLive server (free and open source) running on a computer, ideally one with an NVIDIA graphics card. Small models also run on the processor alone.

server_help_2.message: Then type its address here: the computer's IP and the port, e.g. 192.168.1.10:9090. If it runs on this same computer, localhost:9090.

server_help_3.message: To download and manage models from this page, add the Stream Transcription add-on to the server.

error_capture.message: This tab can't be captured (browser pages, extension stores and PDFs are off limits).

error_no_media.message: There's no video or audio on this page.

error_server_full.message: The server is busy. Estimated wait: {0} min.

error_model_load.message: ⚠ Not enough graphics memory (VRAM) on the server for this model. Pick a smaller model, or turn on “Save memory (int8)” in Advanced.

warn_no_response.message: ⚠ Subtitles have stopped although there is sound. The model probably doesn't fit in the server's graphics memory (VRAM): pick a smaller model or turn on “Save memory (int8)” in Advanced.

warn_slow_load.message: ⚠ The model is taking too long to load. It may not fit in the server's graphics memory (VRAM): pick a smaller model or turn on “Save memory (int8)” in Advanced.

error_reload.message: Reload the page (F5) and start again.

confirm_delete.message: Delete {0} from the server? It frees {1}.

add_model_hint.message: Paste the name or the link of a model on Hugging Face. Any Whisper model works: faster-whisper (CTranslate2) models are used as they are, and normal ones (transformers) are converted automatically. A direct link to a .zip or .tar.gz with a model also works.

browse_hf.message: Browse Whisper models on Hugging Face

vram_hint.message: Bigger models are more accurate but need more GPU memory: small ≈ 1 GB, medium ≈ 2 GB, large ≈ 4 GB.

keep_open.message: Keep this page open until the download finishes.

plain_server_hint.message: This is a standard WhisperLive server: type a model size (tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3, large-v3-turbo) and the server downloads it the first time. To download any model from here, install the Stream Transcription add-on on the server.

position_reset_done.message: Done: they'll go back to the bottom.

performance_hint.message: If the server's graphics card runs out of memory (subtitles that never arrive, or a memory warning), these two options free a lot of it. They only work with the Stream Transcription server.

precision_hint.message: int8 uses about half the graphics memory and, in practice, writes the same text.

translator_device_hint.message: On the processor it frees graphics memory, but translated subtitles arrive a little later.

about_text.message: Free software (MIT license). The audio only goes to the server you set up here; nothing is sent anywhere else.

subtitle_preview.message: This is how your subtitles will look.

err_invalid_source.message: That isn't a Hugging Face model name or a link.

err_unsupported_url.message: Only Hugging Face links or direct links to .zip / .tar.gz files.

err_repo_not_found.message: That model doesn't exist on Hugging Face (check the name).

err_gated_repo.message: That model asks you to accept its terms on Hugging Face; the server needs an HF_TOKEN.

err_no_weights.message: That repository has no model weights.

err_network_error.message: Network error. Try again: it resumes where it stopped.

err_bad_archive.message: The archive is damaged or unsafe.

err_management_disabled.message: Model management is turned off on this server.

err_is_default.message: That's the server's default model; it can't be deleted from here.

err_in_use.message: A running transcription is using it.

err_not_found.message: That model is no longer on the server.

err_timeout.message: The server didn't answer in time.
